baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reciprocal verb at word 1 governs the ongoing seeing at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sharp interpersonal contention is laid over an act of direct perception: the audience does not merely ask for clarification but enters a contest with the seer about what remains present to his seeing.

activation_trace.role: Contentious disputing supplies the social collision and makes the question adversarial.
Eye-or-insight perception keeps the dispute attached to an actual act of seeing.

changed_reading.before: Are you asking him about what he sees?
changed_reading.after: Are you entering sharp contention with him over what he is seeing?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تمارونه can target a person while على ما يرى specifies the ground of the challenge.
baseline_models.mechanism: The challenge can deny the seer's epistemic claim or due standing, not merely express private uncertainty; perception becomes testimony whose entitlement to count is being repudiated.

activation_trace.role: Denial of a right or claim turns disputation into repudiation of epistemic standing.
Reflective judgment lets the challenged claim include insight and considered recognition, not optics alone.

changed_reading.before: You doubt the content of his vision.
changed_reading.after: You repudiate his claim to speak from what he has perceptually recognized.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pressure of تمارونه remains directed to him and bounded by ما يرى.
baseline_models.mechanism: The draw-out branch makes the verbal contest resemble repeated urging that extracts latent yield: questioning presses the seer to produce, elaborate, or exhaust what the seeing contains.

activation_trace.role: Rubbing or urging until stored capacity is drawn out supplies an extractive mechanism for the questioning.
Perception is the bounded reservoir from which the challengers try to draw further account.

changed_reading.before: They simply contradict a report of seeing.
changed_reading.after: They press him in order to draw an account out of what he is seeing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The seeing verb can hold insight and judgment while remaining the explicit object of contention.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two cognitive acts are opposed: his perception has matured into reflective judgment, while their reciprocal disputing attempts to reopen or destabilize that judgment.

activation_trace.role: Doubt and hesitation supply the destabilizing pressure exerted by the audience.
Opinion and reflective judgment broaden seeing into an epistemic conclusion.

changed_reading.before: The verse concerns disagreement about a visual object.
changed_reading.after: The verse contests whether his perceptive judgment may stand without being forced back into hesitation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The non-dominant mapped target of تمارونه remains tied to word 1, opposite the stable present يرى.
baseline_models.mechanism: Oscillating motion recasts disputation as an attempt to make the seer sway back and forth over his perception; instability is something the interlocutors impose rather than a defect already inside the sight.

activation_trace.role: Back-and-forth surging gives the dispute a kinetic role: induced epistemic wavering.
Ongoing perception provides the stable axis around which the challengers try to make him sway.

changed_reading.before: The seer may himself be uncertain about what he sees.
changed_reading.after: The audience tries to make him waver over a perception presented as ongoing and stable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Speech is detached from self-inclination and identified with hidden imparting; the focus dispute therefore reaches beyond a private visual episode into the integrity of a source-to-perception-to-speech transmission chain.

activation_trace.role: Contentious disputing is the attack applied to the transmission chain.
The split report-relaying branch allows seeing to activate as testimony carried onward in speech.
Articulate speech supplies the public output whose provenance is at issue.
Self-inclination supplies the explicitly excluded rival source for that speech.
Knowledge imparted covertly supplies the alternative input that passes into the spoken account.

structural_cues: The paired negations in 53:3-4 exclude self-origin and restrict the speech to imparted communication.
The focus keeps the same challenged person as object of dispute while shifting attention to what he sees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech, excluded inclination, covert imparting, and seeing; I infer a directional chain from imparting through perception into testimony. A live alternative is that the speech and sight are parallel credentials rather than stages of one transfer.

changed_reading.before: They dispute a man's private vision.
changed_reading.after: They attack the reliability of a revealed report at the perceptual link by contesting what its bearer sees.

context_deltas.mechanism: Approach, descent from above, bow-scale measurement, and imparting form a spatially ordered encounter. The focus seeing is no longer unlocated assertion but perception generated within an approach whose distance is twice calibrated before communication occurs.

activation_trace.role: Disputation challenges the account produced by the measured encounter.
Direct perception anchors the spatial sequence back in the focus wording.
Approach supplies decreasing distance as the first movement toward perceptual contact.
Hanging or descending from above supplies the vertical component of the encounter.
The bow-length measure turns nearness into a specified scale rather than vague intimacy.
Measuring one thing by another reinforces calibration as a feature of the scene.
Covert imparting supplies the event reached after the approach and measurement.

structural_cues: The sequence advances by ثم and ف from approach through distance to communication.
The comparative alternative in 53:9 narrows rather than dissolves the proximity claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered motion, a distance measure, and imparting; I infer that they specify conditions under which the focus seeing acquired content. The live alternative is that the motion characterizes the messenger alone and does not calibrate the seer's perception.

changed_reading.before: The disputed seeing is an unsupported, placeless claim.
changed_reading.after: The disputed seeing belongs to a sequenced and spatially calibrated encounter culminating in imparted content.

context_deltas.mechanism: The inward heart and the act of seeing are placed in a non-falsifying relation immediately before the challenge. The focus becomes a credibility hearing in which perceptual occurrence and inward registration corroborate one another before outsiders contest them.

activation_trace.role: Claim-denial identifies what the outside challenge does to already internally corroborated testimony.
Eye-or-insight perception is the testimony under challenge.
The negated opposite of truth supplies an explicit integrity test that the inward witness passes.
The heart as inwardly kindled center supplies a second register for the perceptual event.
The first seeing occurrence binds the heart's truthfulness to the same perceptual domain repeated in the focus.

structural_cues: 53:12 immediately follows the heart's non-falsification in 53:11.
ما رأى becomes ما يرى, changing completed seeing into a present act while preserving the object frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a heart, negated falsification, and repeated seeing; I infer corroboration between inward registration and perception. A live alternative is that the heart itself is the perceiver, making this one integrated witness rather than two corroborating registers.

changed_reading.before: The audience challenges an unsupported sensory report.
changed_reading.after: The audience repudiates testimony already presented as concordant between seeing and inward registration.

context_deltas.mechanism: A further seeing at another single descent and the later seeing of manifest signs turn the focus present into part of a repeated series with temporal units and marked objects. Recurrence raises the cost of dismissing the event as a fleeting anomaly.

activation_trace.role: Doubt and hesitation are tested against recurrence rather than a lone report.
The focus present seeing is the series member being contested.
A second explicit act of perception supplies repeatability.
A single descent packages the repeated perception into a countable episode.
Another seeing extends the chain from encounter to observed signs.
Manifest marks give the later seeing discriminable evidentiary objects.

structural_cues: 53:13 adds another occurrence, and 53:18 resumes the same perfect seeing formula.
The focus present tense sits between completed and repeated seeing statements.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated seeing, one descent, another occurrence, and manifest marks; I infer an evidentiary series. The live alternative is that these are distinct sights whose plurality does not establish repeatability of one object.

changed_reading.before: They question a single exceptional glimpse.
changed_reading.after: They keep doubting a present perception embedded in repeated, episode-marked seeing of manifest signs.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covering surrounds the scene, yet the eye neither tilts or tires nor crosses its limit. Activated beside the oscillation branch of the focus dispute, this transfers instability away from perception and onto the challengers' attempt to make the seer waver.

activation_trace.role: Oscillating motion supplies the instability that the context reallocates to disputation.
Ongoing seeing supplies the perceptual axis tested for stability.
A cover laid over and concealing the scene supplies adverse visual conditions rather than effortless exposure.
The eye's possible inclination or fatigue names underreach and then explicitly negates it.
Ocular seeing identifies the faculty whose calibration is being asserted.
Crossing a boundary names visual overreach and then explicitly negates it.

structural_cues: The balanced ما...وما in 53:17 closes off both falling short and exceeding the limit.
The covering of 53:16 precedes rather than cancels the claim of visual calibration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, an eye, and negated deviation and excess; I infer that stable boundedness belongs to the perception while wavering is induced socially. A live alternative is that 53:17 praises composure without answering the audience's epistemic challenge.

changed_reading.before: Dispute may reflect instability within the vision itself.
changed_reading.after: The vision is bounded against both drift and excess; the wavering motion belongs to those trying to destabilize its witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later epistemic field contrasts compelling proof and disclosure with tracking conjecture and self-inclination. The focus question becomes asymmetric: direct, bounded seeing is cross-examined while unsupported naming and desire are allowed to generate claims.

activation_trace.role: Repudiation of a claim names the burden imposed on the seer's evidence.
Perceptive judgment is the evidence-bearing cognition placed against conjecture.
Compelling proof supplies the warrant explicitly absent from the rival claims.
Tracking trace after trace supplies a procedure that is captured by conjecture instead of evidence.
Doubtful imagining supplies the weak surrogate that the audience follows.
Inclination of the self supplies the directional bias behind that surrogate.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the missing epistemic state explicitly denied to them.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the standard conjecture cannot replace.

structural_cues: 53:23 and 53:28 repeat the exclusive following of conjecture.
53:28 frames conjecture as unable to avail against truth at all.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies absent proof, repeated conjecture-following, self-inclination, lack of knowledge, and truth; I infer a reversed burden of evidence feeding back into 53:12. A live alternative is that the later indictment concerns only idol naming, though its repeated epistemic vocabulary still activates the focus challenge.

changed_reading.before: Two parties hold competing but comparable interpretations of a vision.
changed_reading.after: Those governed by conjecture and inclination impose doubt on the one claim anchored in disciplined seeing, exposing an asymmetric evidence standard.

context_deltas.mechanism: A mirrored question asks whether the turner-away owns knowledge of what is hidden and therefore sees, while human effort is later promised public visibility. The focus challenge reverses onto its challengers: they reject witnessed seeing while acting from presumed access to the unseen, and their own conduct will become the seen object.

activation_trace.role: Contentious disputing supplies the challengers' present action that can itself be exposed.
Actual perception provides the criterion against which presumed unseen access is measured.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the knowledge the rival would need for his claimed seeing.
What is screened from eyes supplies the inaccessible domain the rival implicitly claims to command.
Seeing appears in a mirrored interrogative that tests the opponent rather than the original seer.
Action and earning supply the challengers' own eventual evidentiary object.
Making something seen converts private action into future public disclosure.

structural_cues: The interrogative of 53:35 echoes the focus question but relocates the burden onto another claimant.
The passive seeing in 53:40 reverses human beings from viewers into objects made visible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden knowledge, a mirrored seeing question, effort, and future visibility; I infer a reversal of evidentiary position onto the challengers. A live alternative is that the later passages address a different person and only analogically illuminate the focus.

changed_reading.before: Only the seer's perceptual standing is on trial.
changed_reading.after: The question also puts the challengers' presumed unseen knowledge on trial and anticipates their own deeds becoming visible evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact dispute root returns over the Lord's benefits after the surah's signs, judgments, and reversals have accumulated. This folds the interpersonal challenge of 53:12 into self-implicating denial: disputing the seer becomes doubting or repudiating what has been continuously given and shown.

activation_trace.role: Claim-denial supplies the initial outward repudiation directed at the seer.
Perception keeps the later recurrence tied to what was shown rather than to an abstract theme.
Benefits supply the accumulated givens over which doubt now turns.
Nurturing, repair, and completion make the benefits a sustained process rather than isolated favors.
The repeated doubt branch turns the earlier public contest into the addressee's own hesitation before accumulated evidence.

structural_cues: The same root recurs in another interrogative at 53:55.
The later verb no longer places an external seer between the addressee and the disputed givens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact root recurrence, benefits, and lordly nurture; I infer that the later self-directed doubt diagnoses the earlier attack on the seer. A live alternative is that 53:55 opens a separate reckoning over favors without retrospectively redefining 53:12.

changed_reading.before: They dispute one person's visual claim.
changed_reading.after: Their dispute with the seer is an early form of their own doubt toward an accumulated history of benefits and signs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence moves from renewed report through astonishment and heedless uprightness to lowered posture. It recasts the focus controversy as a politics of response: continued debate keeps the audience aloof, whereas the demanded answer to seeing is an embodied surrender of height.

activation_trace.role: Verbal contention supplies the distancing posture that the closing sequence overturns.
Perception remains the evidentiary event to which a response is owed.
Speech continually renewed as report carries the perceptual claim into the audience's present hearing.
Astonishment before the unfamiliar supplies an affective deflection short of acceptance.
Raised head and standing supply the bodily image of aloof resistance.
Lowering the head and bending supplies the terminal bodily reversal of that resistance.

structural_cues: The closing interrogative about the report echoes the focus interrogative about seeing.
The sequence culminates in an imperative, converting evaluation into required response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies renewed report, astonishment, raised posture, and bowing; I infer a movement from evasive verbal distance to embodied acknowledgment. A live alternative is that the final command is general worship rather than a specific answer to the earlier perceptual dispute.

changed_reading.before: The question asks only which proposition the audience accepts.
changed_reading.after: The question exposes a resistant posture toward seeing that the surah finally answers by reversing the body's height.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant report-relaying target under a verb ordinarily read as seeing. It remains anchored to the exact focus root and to the explicit interpersonal dispute, but downstream prose should mark report-bearing as a split-root resonance rather than a lexical replacement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus seeing at word 4 is what the interlocutors contest and therefore what must pass into an account.

activation_trace.role: Relaying report or poetry recasts the seen content as something borne onward in narration.
Contentious disputing supplies the hostile reception awaiting that borne report.

changed_reading.before: What he sees remains a private visual content.
changed_reading.after: What he sees is already incipient testimony, carried outward as a report that others contest.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because quenching belongs to the secondary mapped target rather than ordinary visual semantics. It remains anchored in يرى and clarifies a possible contrast between settled perception and manufactured doubt; downstream prose should present it as an epistemic material analogy, not as a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يرى names the focus's positive cognitive event while تمارونه applies doubt to it.

activation_trace.role: Quenching and release from thirst model perception as an intake that reaches sufficiency.
Doubt and hesitation attempt to reopen lack after the perceptual intake has settled it.

changed_reading.before: Seeing adds one debatable datum to an unresolved question.
changed_reading.after: Seeing has epistemically quenched the witness, while disputation tries to manufacture thirst again.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material reading is surprising because it activates bright hard stone within the dispute root. It remains directly anchored to تمارونه and is paired with visible appearance in يرى, but prose should qualify the spark-producing collision as a branch analogy rather than claim stone imagery in the surface verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The dispute at word 1 strikes against the visible content held at word 4.

activation_trace.role: Bright hardness makes the disputed datum resistant material against which verbal collision can strike.
Visible appearance supplies luminosity and manifest surface to that resistant datum.

changed_reading.before: Argument clouds an inherently soft and ambiguous impression.
changed_reading.after: Argument strikes a bright, resistant perceptual datum and generates heat without dissolving what was seen.

strongest_changes: The immediate heart/seeing pair turns the focus into a credibility challenge against internally concordant testimony.
Repeated descents, manifest marks, and a bounded eye make the seeing episodic, calibrated, and resistant to dismissal as a fleeting anomaly.
Later conjecture, desire, absent proof, and truth reverse the burden of evidence onto the challengers.
The exact recurrence of م ر ي at 53:55 internalizes the earlier interpersonal dispute as doubt before accumulated benefits and signs.
summary.what_was_special: Split-root branches remained live rather than being collapsed: oscillation relocated instability to the challengers, report-bearing linked sight to testimony, and quenching modeled perceptual sufficiency. Spatial calibration and the final posture reversal supplied independent coexisting mechanisms rather than one harmonized reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The heart may corroborate the eye as a second register or may itself be the single faculty that sees.
The approach-and-measure sequence may calibrate the seer's encounter or only describe another participant's motion.
The non-dominant م و ر and ر و ي activations are structurally licensed but remain form-distant and should not displace the dominant roots.
The late recurrence and closing posture may retrospectively diagnose 53:12 or may operate as analogous later scenes rather than direct revisions.
